pokedexEntries.go: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

pokedexEntries.si: By reading air currents, it can predict things such as the weather or its foe’s next move.

pokedexEntries.cr: The tip of its forked tail quivers when it is predicting its opponent’s next move.
